text: Orbit refers to the path that a planet or celestial body follows around its star or other massive object. Craters are natural features on the surface of a planet or celestial body that have been eroded by the force of weathering and erosion. In astronomy, the term "orbit" is used differently than it is in other fields of science, as it is used to describe the path a planet or celestial body takes around a star or other massive object.
